videos.title: Would you want to know if Ghostface is at your door?
videos.description:
Would you want to know if Ghostface is at your door? New AI-powered text descriptions on Ring, Nest, and Apple Home-compatible video doorbells claim to tell you exactly what's happening on your porch without making you wait for a video clip to buffer. I put them to the test to see how smart they are, and if any of them could catch Ghostface. Read my full review at theverge.com.

videos.title: Meta Connect Impressions
videos.description:
